training_weather.source: Embedded matched ResStock weather; county-assigned Hayward baseline

prediction_weather.source: NOAA primary observations; flagged bias-adjusted secondary-station gap replacements
prediction_weather.method: Backup plus mean primary-minus-backup difference by local month/hour
prediction_weather.validation: Days 10–11 each month withheld from offsets
prediction_weather.limitation: Validation measures typical withheld days, not error at unobserved outage temperatures

backup_gap_policy.gap_policy: Linear elapsed-time interpolation for bounded interior gaps only; no edge filling
backup_gap_policy.aggregation: Mean of accepted reports per UTC hour; not a time-weighted temperature integral

limitations: Temperature-only response; no humidity, thermal lag or equipment saturation.
Fixed population and equipment; no automatic adoption/growth trend.
Deterministic hourly schedules; not individual appliance event simulation.
